_help: Starter list for the private commercial opportunity register (/admin/business/opportunities/, button 'Load the starter list'). Loaded once into D1 table opportunities, then edited there. value and cost are pounds per year and ownerHours hours per year: null unless derived from a recorded fact, which the evidence field states. Scores (1 to 5): customer value, profitability, scalability, feasibility, strategic importance. Research: docs/commercial-2026/08-commercial-strategy.md.

items.title: Core Emergency Ultrasound course: fill every date
items.customer: Emergency and acute clinicians in Kent and London
items.description: The existing one-day course. Maximum gross per date is capacity times price.
items.evidence: data/courses.json: 25 places at £375 on 21 December 2026 = £9,375 gross if full. Costs not yet recorded.
items.requirements: Venue, faculty at one instructor per four or five delegates.
items.next: Record venue and faculty costs for 21 December in the ledger; track paid places weekly.

items.title: FAMUS-approved course centre
items.customer: Acute medicine trainees and clinicians seeking FAMUS accreditation
items.description: Run a FAMUS-approved course (SAM approval per course run).
items.evidence: SAM website: £200 per course run payable to SAM; first course delivered with a FAMUS committee member on the faculty; minimum standards document to be read.
items.development: Course programme to SAM minimum standards; faculty with FAMUS credentials.
items.requirements: Written SAM approval before advertising as FAMUS-approved.
items.next: Read SAM's minimum standards document; draft a programme and a costed plan for owner review.

items.title: Tailored training for teams and organisations (UK)
items.customer: Departments, trusts, private clinics, training groups
items.description: Quoted programmes at the customer's site or a venue we arrange.
items.evidence: 1 department enquiry received (9 October 2026). No quotes or bookings yet.
items.development: Enquiry form and pipeline built; quotation framework in docs/commercial-2026/08-commercial-strategy.md.
items.requirements: Invoicing; NHS procurement where relevant; conflicts-of-interest declarations.
items.next: Respond to each enquiry within five working days; record stages and quotes.

items.title: International tailored training
items.customer: Overseas hospitals, clinics and education providers
items.development: International section and form fields built.
items.requirements: Insurance, local regulation, equipment logistics, travel; price must carry all of these.
items.next: Measure international enquiries for six months before investing.

items.title: Institutional logbook and supervision dashboard
items.customer: Trusts, deaneries, private hospitals and training programmes
items.description: Organisation-level dashboards, aggregate progress and supervisor coordination, licensed per organisation or programme.
items.evidence: Not validated. The free logbook has 7 app accounts (10 October 2026).
items.development: Organisation model, consent and governance for sharing individual progress, admin roles, reporting.
items.requirements: DPIA, data processing agreements, NHS procurement, information governance approval.
items.next: Interview three training leads about the problem before building anything.

items.title: Professional-body collaboration: logbook evidence formats
items.description: Agreed export formats or verification arrangements for supervisor and evidence records.
items.evidence: Each body publishes its own process; none has an agreement with Wavelength.
items.development: Export formats exist (PDF, Excel, CSV, verified summary).
items.requirements: Written agreement before any claim of integration or endorsement.
items.next: Owner reviews the draft proposals in docs/commercial-2026/08-commercial-strategy.md before any contact.

items.title: Specialist courses (thoracic, DVT, vascular access, nerve blocks)
items.customer: Clinicians who completed the core course
items.description: Follow-on hands-on days; nerve blocks as a separate course.
items.evidence: Site lists 'Specialist courses follow' with a keep-me-informed email. Interest not yet counted.
items.requirements: Faculty credentials per module; no accreditation claims without approval.
items.next: Count interest from enquiries and the newsletter for three months.

items.title: Recurring online case reviews or refresher sessions
items.description: Regular online teaching or case-review subscription.
items.development: Content plan, platform, payment (needs owner approval).
items.requirements: Ongoing teaching workload; clear cancellation terms.
items.next: Test demand with a free pilot session and a waiting list.

items.title: Disclosed equipment sponsorship of courses
items.description: Machines or support for course days, disclosed, with no influence on teaching or sign-off.
items.requirements: Editorial and clinical independence; NHS conflicts-of-interest declarations.
items.next: Draft a sponsorship and independence policy for owner approval.

items.title: Optional premium digital features
items.description: Additional value only (for example advanced analytics or revision programmes); the core logbook and sign-off stay free.
items.development: Feature research; payment model needs explicit owner approval.
items.requirements: Never charge for mandatory sign-off or access to existing records.
items.next: Ask users which extra features they would value; do not build until demand is shown.
